# Mark Tab as Unread (toggle_tab_unread): a dot beside the tab's name says
# you meant to come back to it, the tab in front's too. It stays until you
# select the tab again from another one, or mark it read; moved to a
# window of its own and back, closed and brought back with Undo, and
# saved with the window, a document tab's too.
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:later
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-tab:later
expect-news:0
action:toggle_tab_unread
wait:0.3
expect-news:1:later
shot:tab-unread.png
# From another tab, still marked; selected again, read.
tab:new
wait:0.5
expect-news:1:later
tab:1
wait:0.5
expect-news:0
# The palette says what it would do now.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:mark tab
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Mark Tab as Unread
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-news:1:later
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:mark tab
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Mark Tab as Read
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-news:0
# Marked in front and then left, it stays marked till you come back.
tab:2
wait:0.3
action:toggle_tab_unread
tab:1
wait:0.3
expect-news:1
tab:2
wait:0.3
expect-news:0
# It goes where the tab goes, and is saved with the window.
tab:1
wait:0.3
action:toggle_tab_unread
wait:0.3
expect-news:1:later
action:move_tab_to_new_window
expect-windows:2
take-tab:1
wait:0.5
expect-windows:1
expect-news:1:later
roundtrip:go
# Closed and brought back, it's still marked (tab 1, marked in front;
# closing it brings later forward, which reads it).
tab:1
wait:0.3
expect-news:1:later
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:first
key:enter
wait:0.5
action:toggle_tab_unread
wait:0.3
expect-news:2
key:cmd+w
wait:0.8
expect-tab-count:1
expect-news:0
undo:go
wait:0.8
expect-tab-count:2
expect-news:1:first
# A document tab keeps its mark too.
open:@ROOT@/docs/CHANGELOG.md
wait:0.6
action:toggle_tab_unread
wait:0.3
expect-news:2
roundtrip:go
tab:1
wait:0.3
expect-news:1:CHANGELOG
# The tabs along the top show the dot too.
action:set_setting:tab-bar=top
wait:2.0
expect-strip:later
shot:tab-unread-strip.png
action:reset_setting:tab-bar
wait:2.0
expect-news:1:CHANGELOG
